_about: The busy page's words (apps/busy-worker, README 'Words'). English is the source; every other language is a machine draft, shown with its 'machine' label until a person checks it. Keys: heading (also the tab title), body, start (link to beanpool.org/start), find (link to the communities map), apps (members' apps keep working), machine (the draft's label; absent in English). Plain, calm words; never the two words the project bans (scripts/words/GLOSSARY.csv).
